problem_statement: The OA/LP (open addressing / linear probing) hashmap implementation returns incorrect results when re-inserting an entry at a key that was previously removed. After removing an entry, the user expects the entry to be fully erased. However, when re-inserting at that key without a rehash occurring, sys_hashmap_insert returns 0 (indicating a replacement) and reports the old removed value via old_value, instead of returning 1 (indicating a new insert) with old_value left unchanged. This violates the hashmap interface specification that sys_hashmap_remove erases the entry associated with a key.
